pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions exhibit a medium-brown hue with soft, low-contrast pixel gradients at the boundaries. Shapes are predominantly irregular polygons, with larger surface area coverage on the neck and shoulder, transitioning to smaller, more disparate clusters on the posterior flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light-colored negative space creates a continuous network of cream-toned pathways. Junction nodes are numerous and predominantly tri-point. Pixel thickness of the corridors remains relatively consistent across the mid-flank, with increased frequency of nodes towards the ventral and posterior regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The dorsal mane presents a jagged 1D profile with high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks corresponding to individual hair tufts. The serration is visible against the blurred background from the mid-neck to the shoulder transition.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple faint, linear, horizontal marks across the mid-flank suggest healed superficial trauma. A single dark, circular punctate anomaly is visible on the mid-anterior flank.
